001package dayplanner;
002
003
004/**
005 * <p>
006 * Represents an activity outside the home and school categories, with an
007 * associated location such as a clinic or gym. Common fields and behavior are
008 * inherited from {@link Activity}.
009 * </p>
010 * <p>
011 * Example:
012 * </p>
013 * <code>new OtherActivity("Appointment", start, end, "Clinic")</code>
014 */
015public class OtherActivity extends Activity {
016    private String location;    // Required
017
018
019
020    /*
021     * Constructors
022     */
023    
024    /**
025     * Constructs an <code>OtherActivity</code> with a title, start time, end time,
026     * and location.
027     * 
028     * @param title     The activity title.
029     * @param startTime The start time.
030     * @param endTime   The end time.
031     * @param location  The activity location; this constructor does not reject null
032     *                  or blank values, although the app requires a nonblank
033     *                  location.
034     */
035    public OtherActivity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String location) {
036        super(title, startTime, endTime);
037        setLocation(location);
038    }
039
040    /**
041     * Constructs an <code>OtherActivity</code> with a title, start time, end time,
042     * comment, and location.
043     * 
044     * @param title     The activity title.
045     * @param startTime The start time.
046     * @param endTime   The end time.
047     * @param comment   The activity comment.
048     * @param location  The activity location; this constructor does not reject null
049     *                  or blank values, although the app requires a nonblank
050     *                  location.
051     */
052    public OtherActivity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String comment, String location) {
053        super(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
054        setLocation(location);
055    }
056
057    /**
058     * Constructs an <code>OtherActivity</code> from a RAS (Readable Activity
059     * Serial) string.
060     * 
061     * @param ras Serialized entry.
062     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
063     */
064    public OtherActivity(String ras)
065    throws RasException {
066        super(ras);
067        setLocation(RasParser.location(ras));
068    }
069
070
071
072    /*
073     * Accessors and Mutators
074     */
075
076    /**
077     * Gets the location of this activity.
078     * 
079     * @return The activity location.
080     */
081    public String getLocation() {
082        return this.location;
083    }
084
085    /**
086     * Sets the location of this activity.
087     * 
088     * @param location The new location.
089     */
090    public void setLocation(String location) {
091        this.location = location;
092    }
093
094
095
096    /*
097     * Activity Overrides
098     */
099
100
101    
102    /**
103     * Returns the {@link dayplanner.ActivityType} that corresponds to this
104     * Activity.
105     * 
106     * @return Corresponding ActivityType. For OtherActivities, this is
107     *         <code>OTHER</code>.
108     */
109    @Override
110    public ActivityType getType() {
111        return ActivityType.OTHER;
112    }
113
114
115
116    /*
117     * Object Overrides
118     */
119
120    /**
121     * Determines whether this activity is equal to another
122     * <code>OtherActivity</code>.
123     * 
124     * @param other The other <code>OtherActivity</code> to compare with.
125     * @return <code>true</code> if both activities are equal, <code>false</code>
126     *         otherwise.
127     */
128    public boolean equals(OtherActivity other) {
129        if (other == null)
130            return false;
131        if (!super.equals(other))
132            return false;
133        if (getLocation() == null)
134            return other.getLocation() == null;
135        return getLocation().equals(other.getLocation());
136    }
137
138    /**
139     * Determines whether this activity is equal to another object.
140     * 
141     * @param other The object to compare with.
142     * @return <code>true</code> if the objects are equal, <code>false</code>
143     *         otherwise.
144     */
145    @Override
146    public boolean equals(Object other) {
147        if (this == other)
148            return true;
149        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass())
150            return false;
151        return equals((OtherActivity) other);
152    }
153
154    /**
155     * Returns a string representation of this activity.
156     * 
157     * @return A string representation of this activity.
158     */
159    @Override
160    public String toString() {
161        String ret = String.format("%s (%s - %s at %s)",
162            getTitle(),
163            getStartTime().toString(),
164            getEndTime().toString(),
165            getLocation());
166
167        String com = getComment();
168        if (com != null)
169            ret = ret + " (" + com + ")";
170
171        return ret;
172    }
173
174
175    
176    /*
177     * Serialization
178     */
179
180    /**
181     * Encodes this activity into RAS (Readable Activity Serial) format.
182     * 
183     * @return One-line RAS entry including the location after the inherited fields.
184     */
185    public String toRAS() {
186        return RasParser.serialize(this);
187    }
188}
